commits: b9e69c6 cleanup(core): step 1 — document every pub item (units, invariants, panics), drop unused IntoBipartiteHypergraph trait
ddc4c31 cleanup(core): step 2 — corner-case tests for every public core function
cleanup(core): step 3 — deterministic UnionFind::groups, enclosing group bbox, overflow-safe area/thermal/footprint, NaN-safe from_residual
flaggedFixed: UnionFind::groups returned sets in HashMap order (nondeterministic run to run); now a dense by-root table sorted by smallest member
Layout::bbox(Target::Group) cut off 1 nm when the members' span was odd ((lo+hi)/2 truncation); now rounds the half-extent outward and computes in i64
MosSize::gate_area_um2 multiplied w*l in i64 (overflow panic for sides ~1e10 nm); now in f64
Violation::from_residual mapped NaN to margin 0 (a silent pass) and negative residuals to negative Θ; now NaN/inf saturate to i64::MAX and residual <= 0 gives 0
thermal rise_at subtracted i32 coordinates (overflow for points > i32::MAX apart); now in i64
Layout::footprint_nm2 subtracted extremes in i32; now in f64
flaggedOpen: pin_shares formats a pin name per unit per terminal (2 small allocations per unit) and is O(pins^2) in the final pass; cold path, left as is
lanes module (fearless_simd layer) has no callers outside its own tests; kept as the workspace SIMD layer
Layout::edge_gap and lanes::overlap_area still do i32 coordinate differences; documented precondition (coordinates within +-1e9 nm)
MosSize::w_finger_nm panics on nf == 0 for hand-built MosSize; documented, mos_size() never produces it

seamRequests.item: pnr_core::Layout::bbox / centre / extent return (i32, i32, i32, i32) tuples
seamRequests.change: Return lanes::Box4 (named fields) instead of a positional 4-tuple
seamRequests.why: Positional (cx, cy, hw, hh) tuples are easy to destructure in the wrong order across dp/gp/analog callers

seamRequests.item: pnr_core::units::Unit::sa/sb and PlacedUnit LOD sentinel values (0 / NaN)
seamRequests.change: Use Option<NonZeroU32> for sa/sb rather than 0 = not a MOS finger
seamRequests.why: Sentinel-in-band values; callers must remember the convention

risks: No build was run (per rules): step 2 tests and step 3 edits are reasoned, not compiled
Group bbox now rounds outward by up to 1 nm on odd spans: any downstream test asserting an exact group half-extent on an odd span changes by 1

from_residual now clamps negative residuals to 0 and NaN to i64::MAX; all current callers guard with residual > 0 or violations() > 0, so only hard-tier NaN residuals change (now reported as huge margins)
No SIMD added: the only O(n^2) numeric loops (rises_mc, debug_check_placed) run per epoch or in debug only on tens-to-hundreds of devices; vectorizing would not pay
